title: Sharp asymptotics for higher-order Hardy constants on lattices
summary: We study the optimal constants in higher-order Hardy inequalities on the lattice $\mathbb{Z}^d$. For each fixed $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$, we prove that the optimal constant $\mathcal{C}_\text{opt}^\ell(d)$ in $$ \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}^d} |Δ^{\ell/2}u(n)|^2 \geq \mathcal{C}_\text{opt}^\ell(d)\sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}^d} \frac{|u(n)|^2}{|n|^{2\ell}}. $$ satisfies $$ \lim_{d\rightarrow\infty}\frac{\mathcal{C}_\text{opt}^\ell(d)}{d^\ell} =2^\ell. $$ The proof is based on a Fourier reduction to a family of singular Hardy inequalities on the flat torus, involving the weight \[ ω(x)^{-2\ell}, \qquad…
